name: Rapid Augmentation [Psionic]
body:
With a quick burst of psionic power, you can make slight alterations in your astral suit.

Prerequisite: Augment suit class feature.

Benefit: You can activate your augment suit class feature as a swift action.

Normal: Activating augment suit is a standard action.
